svg.title: Local recorded runtime phases
svg.desc: Exact phase totals from the solution variant of experiments_data.json. 20Ma: Reference index 20.01987 seconds, Read indexes 2.10915 seconds, LIS routine 4.43512 seconds, Candidate scoring 1.96198 seconds, BWT ends 5.48561 seconds, DP fallback 1.59440 seconds; 20Mb: Reference index 19.91390 seconds, Read indexes 2.00959 seconds, LIS routine 2.65579 seconds, Candidate scoring 1.21079 seconds, BWT ends 2.51869 seconds, DP fallback 0.99080 seconds. Phase bars are shown independently. They do not sum to the complete runtime and should not be treated as a full accounting of time.
